result.title: What the Trace Shows and What the Label Says: Auditing Behavioral Detectors in Agent Evaluation
result.summary: LLM agents are often evaluated by reducing execution traces to labels such as final-answer correctness, tool verification, and fault propagation. These labels are measurements produced by parsers, behavioral detectors, and harness rules, and they may not fully capture what the trace shows. We study this in a tool-use setting built on GSM8K, where agents call a calculator whose outputs are occasionally corrupted, giving clear ground truth for what the tool returned, what the model later used, and what the detectors reported. We audit three trace-level detectors across six production models and 30 problems per model. Final correctness, visible re-verification, and fault propagation can disagree in systematic ways. A key failure mode is silent tool-output override: the calculator returns a corrupted value, but the model later uses a different, often correct, value without calling the tool again, so the bad value stops propagating while a verification detector records no re-check. Human review of 90 traces agrees perfectly with the automated labels for final correctness (67/67), fault impact (19/19), and fault relevance (18/18), but only 67/81 for verification; all 14 disagreements fall into four recurring patterns. Execution limits also change the reported result: in an ablation across two models, one ranges from 21/30 to 27/30 correct as step and token budgets change, while the other stays between 27/30 and 29/30. These findings motivate measurement transparency: an automated label should come with the trace evidence behind it, whether the question the detector asks applied to that trace, whether the run was cut off by an execution limit, and any human corrections. Our trace viewer makes this information inspectable alongside the reported results.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 GSM8K 工具调用设定中让计算器偶尔返回腐坏数值，审计「最终正确性」「可见复核」「故障传播」三类 trace 级检测器，发现其标签与轨迹实际内容存在系统性分歧（如静默覆写工具输出），并主张标签应附带轨迹证据与执行预算信息。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「静默覆写」检测与轨迹证据标注思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中答案是否真正使用了工具或视觉证据（对应视觉旁路与信息坍缩），但它研究的是纯文本 agent 的评测标签，与多模态推理状态无直接联系。
